title: Kagamine Rin — Brand New Stage〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thanks for practicing with us again today, Rin!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
No, I was happy to.
I got lots of great practice in!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I'm sure it's tough with all your school and work stuff, but do your best, everyone♪

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Thanks, Rin.
We'll be back for more practice when we can make the time!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: They sure do seem busy...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But being busy means that they're getting lots more chances to make themselves known now♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: And when more people start supporting MORE MORE JUMP!, that brings them closer to their goal of performing at the Dome!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
I wanna see that too.
The girls, performing at the Dome...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: And I also need to improve as an idol so I don't fall behind!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: The way to do that is...!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, special training?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Mhm...!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
You've experienced lots of stuff as an idol, right MEIKO?
So, I want you to do some special training with me and help me improve!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Like that time you came up with practices for us when we all had our training camp!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Ah, that did happen...
Doing 100 sit-ups, all of us going around on seven legs together...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Right! Practice was really tough, but it made it easier for us to all get in perfect sync.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I wanna learn lots from you like I did then!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe, with you asking for my help like this, it wouldn't do not to step up to the challenge.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: So that means...!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes! I'll take on your special training♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
But if I'm doing it, I won't be showing any mercy.
Do you still want to do this?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah...! I'm gonna do my best!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: It's settled, then♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, right! If we're doing special training, why don't we also put on a show together so everyone can see how much we improved?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You'll even put on a show with me?!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Of course. I'm sure this will be a good experience for me, too.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Thanks, MEIKO!
I'm looking forward to the training and our show!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Likewise♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Alright, time for our brutal circuit training!
First up, fifty push-ups!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Huh, isn't that less than what we did at the training camp?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Hehe. After the push-ups, you'll be doing squats, sit-ups, and back exercises.
Fifty reps each.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Whaaat?!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, and I'll throw in fifty jump rope jumps in between each strength exercise.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Eeeeeek!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
S-Still...!
I said I was going to do this, so I've gotta give it my best...!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
You're speeding up!
Try to make slow, deliberate movements!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Okay...!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Huff... Huff...
Now for the jump rope...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Keep your jumps light and rhythmical!
1, 2, 3, 4...!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Huff... Huff...
I-I finished the brutal circuit training...!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Good work! Okay, once you've rested for a moment, it's time for our ever-so-fun singing and dancing♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: E-Eeeeep!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Huff...
I-I somehow made it through another day...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Thank you, MEIKO...!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, good work!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I'm sure you're exhausted from the back-to-back days of training, so let's take tomorrow off so this doesn't start affecting your rehearsals.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Rin's working hard every day.
She's managed to stick with your brutal training.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes. She really is working hard.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So, our little present for our hard worker... Any progress on that?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Yes, it's coming along nicely!
I'm sure Rin will love it.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Thank you, KAITO!
I can't wait to show it to her.
